subject: Request: temporary P1/P2 night-window exception for ClearBay (Nov 28–Dec 05)
messages:
From: Jenny Park <jenny.park@clearbay.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: ops@clearbay.io
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: temporary P1/P2 night-window exception for ClearBay (Nov 28–Dec 05)

Hi Ben / Marissa,

Heads up — we have a planned infrastructure migration at ClearBay next week that will increase error rates and latency for a handful of non-critical endpoints overnight. The migration will be performed by our infra team between 02:00–05:00 PST nightly from Nov 28–Dec 05.

We'd like to request a temporary exception to our P1/P2 response windows during that nightly window so that we can avoid automated SLA crediting and on-call paging for known, planned degradation. Specifically:

- Suspend P1 automatic paging between 02:00–05:00 PST for the dates above; allow us to use the ClearBay ops channel as primary alerting during maintenance.
- For genuine customer-facing outages outside the planned maintenance window, normal SLA behavior should remain.
- We'll provide a daily post-mortem and a read-only telemetry link so Redwood can validate that the issue is contained to planned endpoints.

Attached: draft incident schedule and internal on-call roster for the migration (for visibility).

Please let me know what information you need to approve this exception and any guardrails Redwood requires. We understand this is an exception to contract terms and are open to a limited credit or SLA adjustment if that simplifies things.

Thanks,
Jenny Park
Director, Platform Operations
ClearBay

Attachments: clearbay-oncall-roster-Nov2026.csv (CSV, 12KB), clearbay-sla-exception-summary.pdf (PDF, 48KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference.com>
To: Jenny Park <jenny.park@clearbay.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 11:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: temporary P1/P2 night-window exception for ClearBay (Nov 28–Dec 05)

Jenny — thanks for the heads-up and for the attachments. We can work through this but need a tight mutual action plan and a few non-negotiable guardrails before we can approve an exception. Drafting those now, but high level:

- Scope: we need a clear list of the endpoints/features impacted (URL paths + service owners).
- Monitoring: provide a read-only telemetry link (Grafana/Datadog) with panels for error rate, latency P95, and request volume for the impacted endpoints.
- Rollback trigger: explicit thresholds that will re-enable full paging (e.g., sustained error rate > 5% for 10 minutes for customer-facing endpoints).
- Communication: ClearBay operations will post an automated notice in the Redwood incident channel at start/end of each maintenance window.
- Credits: we can convert any agreed exceptions into a one-time service credit in lieu of automated crediting — we will confirm amounts after we review telemetry.

If you can provide the endpoint list and a telemetry link by EOD Thu (11/26), we can fast-track approval and publish an updated on-call matrix that limits paging between 02:00–05:00 PST for this date range.

Marissa / Sean — looping you both for risk sign-off and to confirm our internal escalation contact during the window. If we approve, Ben on-call will be primary contact and Sean backup. We'll also keep a reduced on-call cascade to avoid waking the entire rotation.

Ben
Sr. Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Quick details:
- Impacted endpoints: /api/v1/payments, /api/v1/reconcile, /ingest/batch/* (see attached CSV with owners).
- Grafana link (read-only): https://grafana.clearbay.io/d/abcd123/maintenance-playbook (panels for error_rate, p95_latency, throughput).
- Rollback trigger: error_rate > 4% sustained for 8 minutes OR p95 latency > 2s for 10 minutes (agreed rollback policy).
- Contact: we'll post a message in #clearbay-maint on Slack at start/end; ops@clearbay.io will also send an email at both times.

We updated the roster and highlighted the primary on-call for each night in the CSV. Let us know if that level of detail works.

—Jenny

Attachments: clearbay-oncall-roster-Nov2026.csv (updated)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Request: temporary P1/P2 night-window exception for ClearBay (Nov 28–Dec 05)

Ben / Sean — after reviewing the endpoint list and telemetry panels, I approve a limited exception with conditions. Summarizing decisions for the record and for the legal/ops teams:

1) Approved window: nightly 02:00–05:00 PST from 2026-11-28 through 2026-12-05. During that window:
   - Automatic P1 immediate paging will be suppressed for incidents affecting only the listed endpoints.
   - P1 paging remains active for any customer-impacting outage outside the listed scope.
2) Required fail-safes (must be in place before the first window):
   - ClearBay provides the Grafana read-only playlist and a public JSON for the endpoint list.
   - Rollback triggers will be instrumented as alerts that re-enable full paging to Redwood if thresholds are exceeded.
   - Daily post-mortem emailed to redwood-escalations@redwood.inference.com within 2 hours of each window end.
3) Compensation: one-time service credit equal to 25% of the monthly usage for the impacted endpoints (final amount to be reconciled after post-mortems).
4) Escalation path while the exception is active: Ben (primary) -> Sean (backup) -> Marissa (final). Ben will be the point in the first two nights; Sean will pick up nights 3–8 per our reduced cascade.

I'll publish this to legal and ops and attach the exception to the HubSpot ticket: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/ticket/CB-9876. Require ops confirmation (Jenny) that the rollback alerts are live before clocking the first window as approved.

Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Operations
Redwood Inference
